concept: MTPLX Sustained versus Turbo presets and which use compiled verify
summary: Turbo is selected automatically for the quantized 27B and 9B flagship models; Sustained for the rest.

facts.text: Turbo is selected automatically for the quantized 27B and 9B flagship models; Sustained for the rest.
Compiled verify is a separate mechanism from the preset: Bonsai, which the README catalog does not list as Turbo, uses the compiled verifier.
2.0.0: the turbo profile defaults to compiled verify with a per-model gate (existing dossier).
2.12.0: Bonsai moves onto the compiled verifier after matching eager in 613 rounds.

Compiled verify has no route for image-bearing context on Flash-Next; those turns fall back to eager (33-50 against 54-61 tok/s text-only), and 2.12.0 reports compiled with an image at 101.6 against 97.2 tok/s.
Eager BF16 rounds are used for contexts past the compiled route's 32,768 tokens and for buffer-growth fallbacks.
Whether the Sustained packs (Qwen 3.5 4B, MiMo 9B, Gemma 4) use compiled verify. No source states it.
Bonsai's preset label is not in the README pack table.
The README pack table lists Sustained for Qwen3.5-4B Optimized Speed and Quality (depth 3), MiMo-V2.6-Qwen-9B (depth 2) and Gemma4 Optimized Speed.
The README lists Turbo for Qwen3.5-9B (tuning on a 16 GB M4 Mac mini lands on depth 1), all Qwen3.8-27B packs at depth 3, and all three Flash-Next packs at depth 3.
Flash-Next Optimized Speed is listed as Turbo, depth 3, and the family accepts up to depth 5.
Gemma4 runs as an assistant pair, so its tuned control is the draft block size and not depth.
Bonsai now uses the compiled verifier and matched eager verification in all 613 rounds checked.
Sending an image to Flash-Next used to force eager verification for the whole conversation; 2.12.0 gives compiled verification at 101.6 against 97.2 tok/s.
Eager BF16 rounds apply to image requests, contexts past the compiled route's 32,768 tokens, buffer-growth fallbacks, warm-restore rounds and single eager passes inside a compiled request.
Sustained Max is Sustained with fans pinned at 100 percent, and a detached watchdog restores automatic fans if MTPLX dies.
A pack can set `recommended_generation_mode` to plain decoding while still shipping its draft head; no shipped pack uses it at 2.12.0.
A pack whose accuracy measurement is unpublished shows "Official MTPLX pack, qualification pending" and exits 0 from `mtplx inspect`; Bonsai 2 shows as verified.

CONTRADICTS: mtplx-flash-decoding-verify-attention-kernel-sdp.md line "the README names compiled verify only for the Turbo preset" as implying Sustained packs never compile: 2.12.0 says Bonsai uses compiled verify, so compile status is per pack and not purely per preset.
